decisions.reason: The firm lacks related knowledge in organic vegan food and consumer marketing, so it cannot interpret early weak market signals or improve the product effectively.
The product builds on the firm's process-engineering and plant-construction knowledge, enabling it to learn from early results and improve the modular extensions.
The product closely aligns with the firm's core chemical and energy-processing knowledge and has a dedicated page indicating stronger early results, so it is retained.
The firm's petrochemical and polymer expertise allows it to assimilate plastic-to-fuel technology, and despite limited early visibility it can be developed further.
